description.narrative: The United Nations Fund for Recovery Reconstruction and Development in Darfur (United Nations Darfur Fund) effectively implements the Darfur Development Strategy and recommendations from the Doha Document for Peace in Darfur. The Fund supports Darfur’s transition from humanitarian assistance to recovery and development.
